column1: # Cytogenetic rearrangements -> the gene pair they create. Read only by
# utils/translocations.py. One row per rearrangement; `bands` empty means the
# row is the conventional reading of the bare form (no bands given), used only
# when it is the single bare row for that notation. Bands are compared at arm +
# major band (q34.1 -> q34). gene_b empty = gene-level only (partner varies or
# no fusion gene). 5' gene first, HGNC symbols; locus partners (IGH, TRA, ...)
# Sources: WHO Classification of Haematolymphoid Tumours 5th ed. (2022), WHO
# Soft Tissue and Bone Tumours 5th ed. (2020), Mitelman database; every row
# also occurs in, or is the counterpart of, a cached trial text (2026-09-24).

column5: Bare t(9;22) in oncology is the Philadelphia translocation; no other recurrent 9;22 fusion.
Bare t(1;19) in ALL trials; the only recurrent 1;19 fusion in paediatric leukaemia.
MLL-AF10. Bare t(10;11) is ambiguous between this and PICALM::MLLT10; shared gene MLLT10.
Bare inv(16) in AML is CBFB::MYH11 by convention.
Paediatric acute megakaryoblastic leukaemia; written p13.3q24.3. Needs bands.
GATA2 enhancer repositioned to MECOM; no fusion gene, so gene-level only.
Same mechanism as inv(3); gene-level only.
AML. Bare t(12;22) is ambiguous between the two rows; no shared gene.
Synovial sarcoma; partner is SSX1, SSX2 or SSX4, so gene-level only.
Ewing sarcoma. Bare t(11;22) is ambiguous (DSRCT, constitutional t(11;22)(q23;q11)); needs bands.
T-ALL. Bare t(8;14) is ambiguous between IGH and TRA; shared gene MYC.
